headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of July 16, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 17.95% compared to SPY's 10.86%. This outperformance indicates that the portfolios are not only generating positive returns but are also effectively navigating current market conditions. The average alpha of 7.09% further emphasizes that the portfolio group is exceeding the benchmark, which can be a valuable signal during times of market stress or uncertainty. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 48.56%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 11.39%, still above the benchmark but highlighting the variance in performance across the portfolio set. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
